caption: A wet paper towel is laid over the top of an upright bottle, and it drapes and clings to the bottle's shape.

sa.check: A wet paper towel is laid over the top of an upright bottle.
It clings to the bottle's shape.

pc.expect: It folds over the shoulders and hangs along the sides, clinging.
pc.fail: It stays flat like a lid; or slides off; or is rigid.

pc.expect: It shows the shape beneath and keeps its own size.
pc.fail: The bottle's shape changes; or the towel grows; or it shrinks.
It rises; or floats; or stands out sideways.

pc.expect: It lies on the bottle, not through it.
pc.fail: It passes through; or the bottle passes through it; or the hands pass through.

pc.expect: One towel and one bottle keep their number.
pc.fail: The towel duplicates; or the bottle vanishes; or the towel turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The towel and the bottle stay the same.
pc.fail: The towel changes colour; or the bottle changes; or the background rearranges.
